Video.summary: Experience the electric intensity of the "Maharashtra derby" as local rivals Pune United and Mumbai Pickle Power clash at the Jio World Garden in a match hailed as one of the season's best. This tie is a masterclass in team resilience and tactical pressure under the lights in Mumbai.
